thag6.2:1.1: Atihitā vīhi, khalagatā sāli, na ca labhe piṇḍaṃ, katham ahaṃ kassaṃ. || ||
thag6.2:2.1: buddham appameyyaṃ anussara, pasanno pītiyā phuṭasarīro hohisi satatam udaggo.
thag6.2:5.1: abbhokāse viharasi, sītā hemantikā imā rattiyo. mā sītena pareto vihaññittho; pavisa tvaṃ vihāraṃ phusitaggaḷaṃ. || ||
thag6.2:6.1: phusissaṃ catasso appamaññāyo tāhi ca sukhito viharissaṃ; nāhaṃ sītena vihaññissaṃ aniñjito viharanto 'ti. || || Tekicchakāni
